When she raised alarm, he fled away.
On the basis of the allegations case crime no.0331 of 2023 was initially lodged under Sections 452, 354 (ka), 504 I.P.C. and Section 7/8 POCSO Act.

sentences.text: Her medical examination was done but nothing of substance was found.
Finding the accused involved in the case as minor he was produced before the J.J.Board.
His application for release into custody of his parents was refused.
His appeal challenging the aforesaid order was also dismissed declining him bail.
4. It is submitted on behalf of the the revisionist that revisionist-girl was found aged about 17 years and the boy was found aged about 15 years 2 months on the date of incident.
He has been falsely implicated on the basis of twisted statements subsequently given by the alleged victim.
It is not possible that boy went inside the house and committed rape, without catching attention of other family members.
Medical examination report does not corroborate the allegations of forcible sexual assault.
It is further argued that social investigation report does not mention anything adverse so as to dissuade the J.J. Board as well as appellate court to decline the bail to the juvenile.
He is in protection home since last more than eight months and that he needs company of his family members for his psychological and mental well-being.
5. Learned AGA has opposed prayer for bail, but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.
6. I went through all the material on record including bail rejection order passed by Juvenile Justice Board.

It appears that the board without any substantive material before it, has given opinion that in fact there is probability of his having been exposed to physical moral, psychological danger or that release may defeat ends of justice and has dismissed the bail application.
The appellate court appears to have agreed with the opinion of the board.
In this case minor was found aged about 15 years and two months and the alleged victim was about 17 years.
The juvenile is in custody since 15.07.2023.

Nothing adverse has been found in social investigation report as regard his behavior,
conduct or antecedents.
7. In my view, the matter does not fall within three exclusionary clauses as provided in proviso to Section 12 of the Act, 2015.

It is settled law that whenever a minor, who is alleged to have committed an offence, is apprehended and produced before the board, he shall be released on bail unless the release is likely to bring him in association with any known criminal or there is likelihood of exposure to moral or psychological danger or that such release would defeat ends of justice

. 
8. In view of the above, especially, in view of the period of incarceration already undergone, the revision is allowed.

The order dated 21.08.2023 passed by Principal Magistrate Juvenile Justice Board, Amroha and order dated 13.10.2023 passed by Special Judge (POCSO Act)/Additional Sessions Judge, Amroha are hereby set aside.

10. It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The trial court/J.J.Board shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led, uninfluenced by any finding or observation whatsoever in this order.
